dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Daddy said that Stormterror must have come because I wanted to climb up the god's statue...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: I'm sorry! I won't ever climb the god's statue ever again... *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos, please don't be angry... *sobs*
